hypotheses.justification: `h` is mentioned nowhere in the statement (the goal only involves `normalCurvatureDerivative g c e`, `sphereMeasure`, `gradientSquareNorm (plusWeylGradient g c e)`, `gradientSquareNorm (minusWeylGradient g c e)`); it is used only to discharge the `FollandMoments` argument of `Angular.integral_normalDerivative_squareNorm_exact`. But `FollandMoments` is itself a theorem of this library, so nothing needs to be assumed: `Angular.actual_sphereMeasure_probability` (SphericalMeasureMass.lean:80) proves the concrete normalized Hausdorff `sphereMeasure` is a probability measure, the second/fourth/sixth moment values are the theorems `actual_spherical_second`, `actual_spherical_fourth`, `actual_spherical_sixth`, combined in `Angular.follandMoments_of_probability` (SphericalSixthMoment.lean:46), and these give `Angular.actual_follandMoments : FollandMoments` (ActualSphericalMoments.lean:12) with no hypotheses at all (the library itself exploits exactly this in `PublishedOrientedData.folland ... := Angular.actual_follandMoments`, WeylEstimates03.lean:19386). Hence deleting `h` keeps the statement unchanged and true, with proof `exact Angular.integral_normalDerivative_squareNorm_exact Angular.actual_follandMoments _ _ hTs hTt`, after adding the import `OAI.Geometry.EinsteinFour.ActualSphericalMoments` (no import cycle: that file only depends on SphericalSixthMoment/SphericalMeasureMass, never on WeylNormal/WeylDerivative). Note the other two hypotheses are *not* removable, and each is independent of the other: `hTs` (symmetry) and `hTt` (zero trace) of the plus block are what make the mixed term `∫ q, pairing (directional Z q) (rotated (directional W q) q)` vanish. `integral_normalDerivative_squareNorm` states the general value as `(gradientSquareNorm Z + gradientSquareNorm W)/16 + (∫ pairing ...)/2`, and by `weightedMixingMoment_symm` (AngularDerivativeMoments.lean:17) the `i=j=k=l` contribution is `(1/6)*∑_i Z_ii` times the trace of W, which is nonzero for a non-trace-free `Z`, so the `/16` formula fails without them; indeed proving them for the actual block requires `RicciThree g` (`actual_plusWeylGradient_symmetric`/`actual_plusWeylGradient_trace`, CurvatureTensors02.lean:4911/4917), which is not available here.
